data.title_en: Erasmus+ Open School for Village Hosts trains rural place-makers in five countries
data.signal: Casa Netural leads an EU Erasmus+ Open School for Village Hosts with an initial grant of 400,000 euros and partners in France, Poland, Latvia, Serbia and Italy. Projects include a Village of Water Wheels in Serbia, a River Keeper Alliance in Portugal and Biodiversity Learning Walks in Latvia.
data.note: Needs a public source URL. John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 21 May 2023 and 2022

data.title_en: Climate Water Project sets out a research programme for water cycle restoration
data.signal: Dr Alpha Lo's Climate Water Project published a research programme on slowing water to recharge land, groundwater as a defence against wildfire, regenerative agriculture and aquifer health, precipitation recycling and groundwater biodiversity.
data.note: Needs a public source URL. John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 11 December 2025

data.title_en: Glasgow School of Art develops a Rural Lab on the Altyre Estate
data.signal: Glasgow School of Art plans a Rural Lab on the 800-year-old Altyre Estate in the Scottish Highlands, with ideas for an ecological field station, a living classroom, an edible forest garden and a forest school. Design Harvests 3.0 could partner on ecological field stations.
data.note: Needs a public source URL. John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 29 May 2026 and 26 April 2024

data.title_en: Report calls for protocols to identify agroecologically appropriate technology
data.signal: A report advocates a transparent framework and protocols for identifying agroecologically appropriate technology, as AgTech markets grow with little input from small agroecological farmers.
data.note: Needs the report title and URL. John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 5 June 2025

data.title_en: Scottish estate measures carbon and biodiversity with eDNA, drones and laser scanning
data.signal: The Bunloit project in Scotland quantifies carbon and biodiversity at a granular level using eDNA, camera traps, drones, terrestrial laser scanning and manual surveys.
data.note: Needs a date. John Thackara, email to Prof Lou Yongqi and Design Harvests, 2022
